headline: OPEC+ Expected to Maintain December Oil Output Steady, Reports Say
summary: OPEC+ is reportedly set to hold its oil output steady for December, according to media reports.
why: OPEC+ production decisions directly influence global crude oil supplies and international energy pricing dynamics.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: OPEC+ supply quotas directly impact global crude oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Maintaining output steady curbs potential supply expansions, supporting current price levels depending on demand forecasts.
